title: RehabImmersive-Kinematic-Analysis: a browser-based kinematic analysis tool for upper-limb rehabilitation in immersive virtual reality
description: Software ecosystem for upper-limb neurorehabilitation combining virtual reality serious games for Meta Quest with a privacy-preserving, browser-based tool for post hoc kinematic analysis. The tool computes clinical metrics (range of motion, movement smoothness and path efficiency) from head and hand motion logs, without external motion-capture infrastructure. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
